items.html: And when you combine them in another way, Arich Anpin and his Nukva are Daat, which includes Chesed and Gevura, deciding between Chochma and Bina, which are Atik and his Nukva. Likewise, Yeshsut are Tifferet, deciding between Aba and Ima, which are Chesed and Gevura. And likewise Jacob and Rachel are Yesod, deciding between Netzach and Hod, which are ZON, as is known — for he is in Netzach and she is in Hod. Understand this very well.
